report: P-3 county job: Griggs County ND, 5 open parks with no PAD-US record at the pin (all State Historical Society of North Dakota (SHSND) 'State Historic Site' units -- small sites, likely no outline regardless, this is an R-G7 step 4b / R-G10 ownership check). Could not find a layer URL myself: the statewide parcel dataset's own announcement page (gis.nd.gov/news/north-dakota-statewide-parcels) only links to 'north-dakota-state-parcel-program-ndgov.hub.arcgis.com', which this session's web allowlist blocks. Please open that hub page, find the actual parcel FeatureServer/MapServer layer it links to (or Griggs County's own if the statewide one excludes it), and query owner name + parcel id at each of the 5 points above. If the statewide layer has no owner field (as ND's parcel programs sometimes only carry APN/acres), note that back to me rather than guessing.
